about_the_game:
DEMO AVAILABLE! ➤


WAVE ONE RELEASED!

John route and Cain route now both available to play. Wave two, Gary and Akio, will be coming next.

As longtime aficionados of both visual novels and romcom anime we've spent the past few years pouring our heart and soul into Goodbye Dreaming, a slice-of-life dating sim that follows Robin as she explores college life and escapes her mother's shadow. Unlike many other dating sims we wanted to create a game that doesn't just end when the characters get together, but also explores the complexities of how the relationship develops afterwards.

We have a cast of six charming characters for the player to romance, but be careful! Not everyone has Robin's best interests at heart.

  • Cain (CV. Tom Aglio) ー [OUT NOW] ー A perpetually tired charmer juggling part-time jobs to provide for his younger sibling, his only present family. Slowly chipping away at his business degree.

  • John (CV. Griffin Puatu) ー [OUT NOW] ー A sporty, well-liked guy that somehow slips everyone's mind. Too nice for his own good, but has trouble opening up to people. Loves to read.

  • Gary (CV. Lucas Gilbertson) ー [COMING IN WAVE 2] ー A happy-go-lucky guy with no personal space bubble. Studying to be a forensic scientist. Intelligent, emotional, and occasionally overwhelming.

  • Akio (CV. Belsheber Rusape) ー [COMING IN WAVE 2] ー A naive, arrogant rich kid who cut ties with his family to pursue his passion for art. Huffy, dramatic, and hates being incapable.

  • Elliot (CV. Brett Bauer) ー [COMING IN WAVE 3] ー A quiet, grumpy guy studying to be a vet. Wants to be cool, but his streak of bad luck and lack of chill always end up sabotaging him.

  • Avalon (CV. Carol Anne Day) ー[COMING IN WAVE 3] ー Robin's best friend since high school and current roomie. Energetic, independent, and meddlesome. A ride or die friend.

And last but not least, the protagonist herself:

Robin (CV. Melissa Dorsey) ー A down-to-earth and quietly sarcastic girl who used to be a goody-two-shoes. Was salutatorian in high school. Cut ties with her mother and ran away to college to discover what she wants from life. Introverted and bookish, but trying to expand her world.

content_descriptors.notes: The game consistently deals with themes of suffering from and recovering from emotional abuse. Depending on choices made, the player can encounter experiences of the main character's anxiety, scenes with manipulative characters, or scenes with violence.

short_description: A visual novel dating simulator following Robin as she discovers herself and escapes her mother's shadow. Set in college, this otome game features six romanceable characters, but be careful: not everyone has Robin's best interests at heart.
